title: Remove Settings builder flat exports
summary: Removed 41 transitional flat Settings builder helper aliases while preserving namespace access on mediaPipelineSettingsView.
reason: WebView flat export cleanup remains an active opportunistic workstream. The removed builder helpers had no direct window.* consumers, and existing browser coverage already exercises the intended mediaPipelineSettingsView namespace access for Settings, Network, and builder flush flows. Launch policy-impact aliases and Raw Action Plan aliases remain flat because current consumers still use them directly.
behavior_before: settingsView.js exposed video, quality, file-safety, network, queue, runtime, pending-publish, and final-library-promotion builder helpers through both mediaPipelineSettingsView and direct window.* compatibility aliases.
behavior_after: The builder helpers remain exported through mediaPipelineSettingsView for existing namespace callers, but no longer create direct window.* aliases. Directly consumed Settings render, Launch policy-impact, Raw Action Plan, patch-state, media-policy cross-check, patch writer, and init aliases remain unchanged. The global export inventory and WebView public contract baseline now report 394 flat exports.
